# Error Translator Docs
 
> Canonical documentation index for Error Translator CLI v2.

Error Translator is an offline Python traceback analyzer, exception explainer, and AST-powered debugging assistant.

## Canonical Docs URL

https://gourabanandad.github.io/error-translator-cli-v2/

- python traceback translator
- python exception explainer
- explain python errors from stack trace
- offline python debugging cli
- python error translation api
- jupyter error translator magic
- python ast error typo suggestion
- python nameerror did you mean
- python typeerror fix
- python stack trace to plain text
- automated traceback triage in ci cd
